integrity: The 57-line incidence computation is exact over Q(epsilon), not sampled numerically. The upper bound uses intrinsic recovery of the Hesse subarrangement; the lower bound uses projective covariance of the point-line operator and the published Hessian-group action.
scientific_limitations: The statement is over C for the explicit H_57 realization; it does not determine abstract incidence-lattice automorphisms or positive-characteristic degenerations.
title: The \(57\)-line Hesse closure has exactly the Hessian projective symmetry group
